cue: Event times are written by the agent, by hand, at minute grain.
lesson: Stamp events by machine when they are written; lead time per step is only as good as these times.
evidence: AIP-2 has 4 to 6 events on the same minute (09:12, 09:21, 09:53), so the time spent in spec review against fixing can't be told apart; one event in AIP-2's thread carried a wrong time and needed an erratum.
